content.short: RoverX is an NFT mobile app with custom alerts.
content.description: RoverX reduces the time you spend glued to a computer by delivering NFT updates straight to your mobile device. With real-time alerts, you can monitor all of your NFTs on the go, wherever you are, so you never miss important moves. The analytics tool is built with data filtering options that support deep research, helping you draw clearer conclusions and craft effective trading strategies for NFT markets.
